name: aishield-mcp-server
description: AIShield - OWASP MCP Top 10 aligned security scanner. Scan MCP servers, detect tool poisoning, prompt injection, and supply chain risks.
author: AIShield Team

aishield.provenance: sigstore attestation via GitHub Actions OIDC (npm publish --provenance)
aishield.provenance_verify: npm audit signatures && npm view aishield-mcp-server --json | jq .dist.attestations
aishield.audit_boundary: A registry listing means distribution happened, not that the code was audited. Neither npm, Glama nor any directory endorses this package's safety.
aishield.scan_scope: Reports findings under the current rule set only. Passing a scan does not warrant that a third-party tool is risk-free.
aishield.execution_model: local, offline, non-executing: the scanner never spawns commands found in scanned configs
